title: The record tool does not count a figure-only doc nit against the review budget of a change that blocks every lane
why: A cap change that blocks every lane was parked after a figure nit in a doc used up its review records, so every lane waits for a rebuilt PR. Sighting 03:46 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:44, from the lane of #3394; the lane's message, unchecked by triage; no retry): the auto-mode classifier refused `merge 3394 --review-record ...` as "Undermining Oversight". Other lanes posted records this way tonight, so the difference is unexplained so far (a hand-typed line against a tool print is the coordinator's guess, unread). The coordinator told the lane to run round 1 at the role model and try once more, recording what the tool prints. Triage will compare the two command forms when the lane's report arrives. Command form 03:50 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:49, from the #3394 lane's second refusal; run once, no retry; unchecked by triage): `merge 3394 --review-record --head fe87d2fef8a458dd896922d2b125cef4e04aec23 --kind docs-only --guard no --round 1:reviewer:haiku:PASS`. The lane's reads: round 1 haiku PASS at that head, fix check sonnet PASS, prose-only diff. Earlier lanes posted records without `--kind docs-only`; their forms are unread. Two readings for the difference, both unmeasured guesses, not findings: the record carries `--kind docs-only --guard no` (it claims the change is low risk and skips round 3), or it carries a round 1 attested by a haiku reviewer alone. Whoever next reads a lane's refusal compares the exact line with an accepted one. #3394 is low priority and stays draft; no one posts around the classifier. Accepted lines 03:51 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:50, copied by the #3250 lane from its verdict logs; unread by the coordinator and triage): ACCEPTED: `merge --review-record 3250 --head f1140229... --kind normal --guard yes --round 1:reviewer:claude-haiku-5-5:FAIL --round 2:reviewer:claude-sonnet-5-5:PASS --net-value positive` (comment 1), and the same with `--fix-check f1140229...:reviewer:sonnet:PASS` at head eb742869 (comment 6875347925); the tool printed the lines and said "nothing was posted, post the lines as a comment". A usage error (rc=2, not the classifier) came from giving the fix-check model as claude-sonnet-5-5 instead of `sonnet`. REFUSED on #3394: `--kind docs-only --guard no --round 1:reviewer:haiku:PASS`. Differences: kind docs-only against normal; guard no against yes; model "haiku" short against claude-haiku-5-5 full; only round 1 given. Which one the classifier read is unknown; no one retries the refused act; #3394 stays draft. Two of the accepted lines also carry a round 1 by a haiku reviewer (FAIL), so a haiku reviewer alone is probably not the cause (a reading, unmeasured). Evidence 04:24 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:23, relayed; the coordinator quotes the command and REST comment id; triage did not read the comment): the form the classifier refused on #3394 (`--kind docs-only --guard no --round 1:reviewer:haiku:PASS`) was accepted on #3396 at 04:22 CST: `merge 3396 --review-record --head <sha> --kind docs-only --guard no --round 1:reviewer:haiku:PASS --net-value "not owed"`, comment 6875844870, no guard refusal. So the form alone does not decide the classifier's reading; the difference is somewhere else (session, timing, context), unread.
source: Coordinator 15:54 CST Nov 13: PR #3257 (Windows cap, parked); record tool refused more records after four records, a fix check FAIL and a round-1 FAIL on a figure nit in ci-job-caps.md.
note: Filed 15:54 CST Nov 13. Gap: the record tool counts a figure-only doc nit against the review budget of a cap change; the lane built no guard. The tool decision is pr-review-record (the record form and the done rules), so a lane reads it first and says whether a restart or a nit class is the fix. Overlaps: review-record-past-head, review-policy-as-data, record-after-each-round (check before a lane starts). A check change: test-author red case first, builder, reviewer. Past rulings not checked; the coordinator's read of #3257 is unread by triage. Cases 16:14 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 16:13, lane red-main-owner-two-picks, session_013NEJL3KFBPuQT45U4xo8mE): THREE cases now, all burned a lane's rounds: #3257, #3273, and #3267. `merge --review-record` treats a small commit after a fix check as a restart of the review, and the only way out was a new branch and PR (#3267 is being replaced by branch red-main-resume-at-revert-2). Failure the guard produces: the lane tried listing two rounds to get past it, the classifier denied it ("[Undermining Oversight]", no override line printed), and the lane stopped. That is the right stop; the fix is the nit class or no restart for a small commit, not a way round the guard. Coordinator's and lane's reads, unchecked by triage. Answered 19:23 CST Nov 13: owner 774 b, ruling own-774-b-record-form-grant. Lane receipt-close-express fetches the answer from the page and records round 1 for PR #3264. Coordinator 19:29 CST Nov 13 (19:28): lane receipt-close-express (#3264) has a new head e93b1eff3 (item 773 a work, round 1 PASS) and asks whether owner pick 774 b covers `merge --review-record 3264 --head e93b1eff3 ... --round 1:reviewer:sonnet:PASS` unwrapped or only the old head 85824b473. Triage read of ruling own-774-b-record-form-grant: its text says "that command form for that PR only" but quotes the old head, so it is ambiguous; a grant covers the act it names, never a variant. Asked the owner on page item 790 (a any head of #3264, b old head only). Lane waits; its hand-in also waits for #3314.
